# Whiteboard "fill viewport" scout — spec

## DOM tree (whiteboard view)

```
html (data-theme=…)
└─ body                              [normal page flow scroll; min-height:100vh]
   └─ #app
      └─ main.board                  [max-width:1400px; margin:auto; padding:32 48 96; pos:relative]
         ├─ header.header            [in normal flow; mb:28px; height row=44]
         ├─ div.notes.notes--whiteboard   [height: calc(100vh - 80px); overflow:hidden; pos:relative]
         │  └─ div.whiteboard        [position:absolute; inset:0; overflow:hidden; touch-action:none]
         │     ├─ div.whiteboard-canvas   [abs; 1×1 px; transform: pan/zoom]
         │     │  └─ .note × N
         │     ├─ canvas.whiteboard-minimap [abs; right:12 top:12]
         │     ├─ div.whiteboard-hud       [abs; left:12 top:12]
         │     └─ div.whiteboard-ai-bar    [abs; left:12 top:48]
         └─ footer.board-footer
```

## Who owns height/scroll today

- **`html, body`** — `min-height:100vh`, NO `overflow:hidden`. Body is what scrolls today.
- **`.board`** — block in flow, `max-width:1400px`, padding `32 48 96`, no fixed height. Lets body grow.
- **`.notes--whiteboard`** — `height: calc(100vh - 80px)` (the "80px" is an approximation of header+padding; this is the current hack). `overflow:hidden`. Min 480px.
- **`.whiteboard`** — `position:absolute; inset:0` inside `.notes--whiteboard`. The actual interactive surface.
- **`.header`** — plain in-flow block, NOT sticky, `margin:0 0 28px`. Header is NOT position:sticky/fixed today.
- **`.board-footer`** — in-flow after notes; in whiteboard mode it sits below the `100vh-80px` block, pushing page height past viewport → causes scroll/whitespace.

## `attachWindowListeners` — does whiteboard need it?

No. `attachWindowListeners` attaches `resize` + `scroll` → `board.rerender()` → `scheduleRender()` → `render()`. In whiteboard mode, `render()` calls `renderWhiteboard()` which just calls `whiteboard.refresh()` (re-mounts visible notes from filter). The whiteboard owns its own pan/zoom/scroll internally; window scroll is irrelevant. The window scroll listener will fire on body scroll (which we want to eliminate anyway) — once body no longer scrolls in whiteboard mode, it becomes a no-op. **No code change required**, but the listener becomes dead weight in whiteboard mode (acceptable; resize is still needed for masonry/list).

## CSS rules that need changing

The cleanest scope: **toggle a `body` (or `html`) class when view switches**, e.g. `body.view-whiteboard`. Set it in `main.ts`'s `onViewChange` + on initial boot, alongside `persistView`. Then add CSS scoped under that ancestor. This avoids touching every selector and keeps masonry/list 100% untouched.

### Required rule changes (under `body.view-whiteboard`)

| # | Selector | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| a | `body.view-whiteboard` | `overflow:hidden; height:100vh` | Kill page scroll. |
| b | `body.view-whiteboard .board` | `max-width:none; margin:0; padding:0; position:fixed; inset:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column` | Make the shell own the viewport, drop centered content cap. |
| c | `body.view-whiteboard .header` | `position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; z-index:10; margin:0; padding:12px 16px; background:rgba(var(--paper-rgb), 0.72); backdrop-filter:blur(10px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)` | Float header over canvas with translucent bg. (Need to either add `--paper-rgb` or use `color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 72%, transparent)`.) |
| d | `body.view-whiteboard .notes--whiteboard` | `height:100vh; min-height:0; flex:1` (or `position:absolute; inset:0`) — and crucially **override the existing `height: calc(100vh - 80px)`** | Canvas fills the whole viewport; header floats *over* it (it's no longer in flow consuming height). |
| e | `body.view-whiteboard .board-footer` | `display:none` (or absolute bottom-right pill if we want to keep the mode indicator) | Footer pushed scroll today. |
| f | `body.view-whiteboard .whiteboard-hud` | `top: 60px` (push below floating header) | Avoid header overlapping HUD. |
| g | `body.view-whiteboard .whiteboard-ai-bar` | `top: 96px` (or bottom-anchor: `top:auto; bottom:16px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%)` for Figma feel) | Same reason. Optional: re-anchor to bottom-center like Figma. |
| h | `body.view-whiteboard .whiteboard-minimap` | unchanged (or bump `top:60px`) | Already absolute, fine. |

### Mobile (`@media (max-width:640px)`)

The existing `@media` block sets `.board { padding: 16px 14px 64px; }`. Need to override under `body.view-whiteboard` (zero padding wins). One extra rule:
- `@media (max-width:640px) { body.view-whiteboard .board { padding:0; } }` (or rely on selector specificity — `body.view-whiteboard .board` is already more specific than `.board`, so the override should hold without the media wrap; verify).

## Gotchas

1. **Header is NOT sticky today**, it's a plain in-flow block. Going from in-flow to `position:absolute` removes it from layout — that's exactly what we want (canvas underneath). Theme toggle / view toggle live inside header; they keep working because we only restyle the wrapper, not internals. Pointer events on the floating header will still beat the canvas because of `z-index:10` and the canvas's `touch-action:none` doesn't block clicks above it.
2. **Translucent header bg**: `--paper` is a hex var, not RGB. Use `color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 72%, transparent)` (modern browser-safe) OR add `--paper-rgb` to both light/dark theme blocks in board.css.
3. **`.notes--whiteboard { height: calc(100vh - 80px) }`** — the "80px" magic number is the current workaround. Our override (rule d) replaces it with `100vh` since the header floats. Keep the override under `body.view-whiteboard` so masonry/list still use the existing rule? — actually `.notes--whiteboard` only ever exists in whiteboard mode (board.ts `containerClassFor`), so we can simplify the base rule too. **Recommended: rewrite the base `.notes--whiteboard` rule directly** since the class is mutually exclusive with the others. Less surface area than two competing rules.
4. **AI bar uses `touch-action:auto`** to override the parent's `touch-action:none` for iOS keyboard. Don't break that.
5. **Minimap is `pointer-events:none`** — fine, no change.
6. **Footer**: `.board-footer` shows "local · sample data" / "connected · d1". In Figma-mode hide it or absolutely position bottom-right.
7. **Mode-switch cleanup**: when leaving whiteboard the body class must be removed; when entering, added. The hook is `main.ts`'s `onViewChange(view)` callback + initial boot block. Trivial.
8. **Editor overlay** mounts on `document.body` with fixed positioning — unaffected by `body { overflow:hidden }`. ✓
9. **`html, body { min-height:100vh }`** — fine; we override with `body.view-whiteboard { height:100vh; overflow:hidden }`.
10. **Window scroll listener** in `attachWindowListeners` — dead in whiteboard mode once body stops scrolling. No code change needed.

## Minimal edit list

**File: `src/main.ts`** (2 small edits)
- Helper `applyViewBodyClass(view: BoardView)` that toggles `document.body.classList` for `view-whiteboard` (and optionally `view-masonry` / `view-list` for symmetry / future-proofing).
- Call it once on boot (after `loadInitialView()`) and inside the existing `onViewChange` callback alongside `persistView` + `board.setView`.

**File: `src/styles/board.css`** (1 new section, 1 base-rule rewrite)
- **Rewrite** `.notes--whiteboard` block (~line 705): drop `height: calc(100vh - 80px)`, `min-height: 480px` — make it `position:absolute; inset:0` directly (since `.board` will become its fixed positioning context in whiteboard mode). Or leave base unchanged and override entirely under `body.view-whiteboard`.
- **Append** a new `=== Whiteboard fullscreen shell ===` section at end of file (before/after the mobile `@media`) containing rules (a)–(h) above, all scoped under `body.view-whiteboard …`. Includes one `@media (max-width:640px)` override for `.board` padding.

**No changes required to**: `board.ts`, `whiteboard.ts`, `header.ts`, `index.html`, `globals.css`.

## Recommended scoping choice

Use **`body.view-whiteboard`** (not `html` data-attribute, not `.notes--whiteboard` ancestor) because:
- We need to change `body` itself (`overflow:hidden`) — easier when body owns the toggle.
- `.board` is a sibling of where the whiteboard div lives; scoping under `.notes--whiteboard` ancestor can't reach `.board` or `.header`.
- A body class is a single source of truth and matches the existing `data-theme` pattern on `<html>`.

Clean typecheck. Done.

- `src/styles/board.css` — appended `=== Whiteboard fullscreen shell ===` section (rules a–h scoped under `body.view-whiteboard`, plus a `@media (max-width:640px)` override for `.board` padding and tighter header padding).
- `implementation-notes/2026-06-08-whiteboard-fullscreen.html` — new (D-1 body-class scoping; D-2 `color-mix` for translucent header; T-1 left base `.notes--whiteboard` rule intact, overrode under body class).

**1. Whiteboard fills viewport, no page scroll — PASS**
`body.view-whiteboard { overflow:hidden; height:100vh }` + `.board { position:fixed; inset:0 }` + `.notes--whiteboard { position:absolute; inset:0; height:100vh }`. Correct.

**2. Masonry/list untouched — PASS**
All new rules scoped under `body.view-whiteboard`. Base `.notes--whiteboard { height: calc(100vh - 80px) }` is overridden only when body class is on. Masonry/list selectors not referenced.

**3. Scroll suppression only in whiteboard, restored on switch — PASS**
`applyViewBodyClass` uses `classList.toggle(name, predicate)` for all three classes on every change → exactly one active at a time, others removed. `overflow:hidden` is scoped to `body.view-whiteboard`, so leaving the mode restores default body overflow.

Header is `position:absolute; z-index:10` over the canvas. Within its bounding box (~48–56px tall, full width) it WILL eat pointer events — that's expected for a real header. That's the Figma model — accept it.

**5. Mobile @media — PASS**
The new `@media (max-width:640px)` block only sets `.board { padding:0 }` and `.header { padding:8px 12px }` under `body.view-whiteboard`. Existing mobile rules at ~line 1017 are not modified. Masonry/list mobile behavior unchanged.

**Caveat (pre-existing, not introduced here):** `height:100vh` on iOS Safari includes the dynamic URL bar, causing ~60–80px of bottom content (the re-anchored `.whiteboard-ai-bar` at `bottom:16px`) to sit under the bar when it's visible. Consider `100dvh` in a follow-up. Not a regression from this diff — the base `.notes--whiteboard` already used `100vh`.

**6. Leaked listeners / stale classes on repeated switches — PASS**
No listeners added in this diff. Class toggling is idempotent (`classList.toggle` with explicit boolean). Repeated switches converge to exactly one `view-*` class. Clean.

**7. TypeScript — PASS**
Implementer reports `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0. Helper is trivial (`BoardView` union already includes `'whiteboard'` per the localStorage branch). No type concerns.

---

## Concrete bugs
None blocking.

## Nits (optional follow-ups, not required to ship)
- `src/styles/board.css` ~line 1063: consider `100dvh` instead of `100vh` for `body.view-whiteboard` and `.notes--whiteboard` to handle iOS URL-bar resize. Pre-existing issue, amplified by going fullscreen.
- Duplicate `=== Whiteboard ...` section headers in the file (one at ~line 696, new one at ~line 1051). Harmless but slightly confusing on grep.
- `.whiteboard-ai-bar` re-anchor drops `right:auto` reset explicitly — good. But `width: clamp(280px, 38vw, 560px)` is inherited; combined with `left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%)` it centers correctly. Verified.

## Verdict
**PASS — ship it.**
